items.source: The artifact ID of the application that is to be processed ahead-of-time.
items.translation: 要提前处理的应用程序的 artifact ID。

items.source: The directory to which AOT-generated classes should be written.
items.translation: AOT 生成的类应写入的目录。

items.source: The group ID of the application that is to be processed ahead-of-time.
items.translation: 要提前处理的应用程序的组 ID。

items.source: The directory to which AOT-generated resources should be written.
items.translation: AOT 生成资源应写入的目录。

items.source: The directory to which AOT-generated sources should be written.
items.translation: AOT 生成源文件应写入的目录。

items.source: Specialization of JavaExec to be used as a base class for tasks that perform ahead-of-time processing.
items.translation: `JavaExec` 类的特化版本，用作执行提前处理任务的基类。
